MAIN ISLAND · FISHING DOCK

A cast of good timing.

Watch for faint underwater shapes, wakes, and brief glimpses at the surface. Aim ahead: the rod bends back and the line whips forward before your bait lands. Original bait is a small worm; the lure panel uses a tiny fishing lure. Each cast uses one bait. When a fish bites, tap R repeatedly (or tap Reel in) to pull it in. Two seconds without reeling lets it escape.

Cast directly into the sea on the map. Arrow keys aim · Enter or Space casts · Escape stops fishing.

    MOONWATER ISLAND · WATERSPORTS

    Catch the wake.

    The tow boat is parked at Moonwater Island’s southern dock. Bring your own wakeboard or waterskis, hold the rope, and ride behind the boat. The boat follows its own safe course. Arrows / WASD steer your rider across the wake; collisions knock you off. The boat then follows the course back to its dock. X drops the rope so you can swim.

    What would you like to use? Choose your wakeboard or waterskis below.

    MAINLAND BEACH · SURF RENTALS

    Catch the southern swell.

    Paddle: arrows or WASD. Press Space / Enter when a crest reaches your board. Waves close to the beach are smaller; paddle farther out for the largest waves.

    Ride: you travel left while the water scrolls right. Use Up/W and Down/S to climb and descend the face. Link turns up and down the face to build speed and outrun the lip chasing from the right. Ride half inside the barrel for 4× line points. Press Space at the crest while carving up with speed to launch an air. Left/right spin in the air; land with the board pointing from straight down (6 o’clock) toward the lower left, short of horizontal (9 o’clock), to earn points and a speed boost. Down helps line up the board. P pauses; X returns to the beach.

      WELCOME, EXPLORER

      A whole archipelago is waiting.

      Walk with WASD or arrow keys, or use the touch arrows. You can also tap any glowing marker to visit it.

      Press E near a marker to solve a math challenge. Use the interactive tools, ask for a hint, and try as often as you like.

      Earn 5 crystals for each discovery. Spend them on your cottage, garden, and bridge. Walk between the main island, Moonwater, and Sunseed. Swim to Whispering Island, or restore the woodland bridge between Sunseed Island and Crystal Cavern. Earn or hold 500 crystals to unlock a speedboat dock with a triple-outboard boat that is 25% faster than the fishing boat. Catch five fish to unlock your own fishing boat, then sail to twelve remote islands with their own docks and practice stops. These outer islands can only be reached by boat. Buy a 25-crystal ferry ticket at the main island dock to sail to the fifth island, Crystal Cavern. Each ticket buys one timed ride. The upper-right countdown shows your time remaining. The ferry stops when time runs out and returns to its dock after you leave. Fish from its deck with F. Owned boats start with full gas tanks, lasting five minutes at top speed; slower speeds use less gas. Catch fish to refill your boat, or fish from shore to build a reserve. Only the speedboat enters darker deep water. At the bottom of the map, Mainland Beach has sunbathers, umbrellas, and volleyball. Buy an anchor for 50 crystals in Gear, then press Q near the beach to park any boat and go ashore. Use X near a dock to step ashore. Your energy meter drains twice as fast while swimming as it does while riding fish or swimming dragons; each correct problem restores 25 energy. At zero energy you return safely to land and must solve a problem before swimming again. After 8 discoveries, your companion hatches! Every 50 crystals earned unlocks a squishy. Explore 200 discoveries and collect all seven squishies!
